Theorem
[Entropy monotonicity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0024 ↗ def:chow-iii-ch17-perelman-entropy-mu-nu 1. ch17:17.11–17.13\group Entropy Functionals

If \[ \partial _tg=-2\Ric ,\qquad \partial _tf=-\Delta f+| abla f|^2-R+ rac n{2 au }, \qquad au '=-1, \] then \[ rac d{dt}\mathcal W(g,f, au )=2 au \int _{\mathcal M} \left|\Ric + abla ^2f- rac1{2 au }g ight|^2u\, d\mu \ge 0. \]
Proof

\sketch For $v=[ au (R+2\Delta f-| abla f|^2)+f-n]u$, direct differentiation gives

\[ \Box ^*v=-2 au \left|\Ric + abla ^2f- rac1{2 au }g ight|^2u, \qquad \Box ^*=-\partial _t-\Delta +R. \]

Since $\mathcal W=\int v\, d\mu $ and $\partial _td\mu =-R\, d\mu $, integration by parts yields $ rac d{dt}\mathcal W=-\int \Box ^*v\, d\mu $.

□
